# innostes UI

> A production-grade design system and React component library engineered for enterprise ERP, HRMS, and CRM platforms. Accessible, WCAG 2.2 AA compliant, and localized.

## Core Documentation
- [Accessibility Statement](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 Level AA conformance, component guarantees, developer responsibilities, and assistive technology testing.
- [Colour](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/colour): OKLCH semantic palette, contrast tokens, functional roles, and verified WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios.
- [Dark Mode](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/dark-mode): Implement dark mode across applications using class-based or data-attribute activation, next-themes, and hydration safeguards.
- [Icons](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/icons): Iconography standards, Lucide React integration, sizing rules inside components, and accessibility requirements.
- [Motion](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/motion): Transition durations, easing curves, and prefers-reduced-motion accessibility standards.
- [Spacing and Layout](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/spacing): 4px base spatial rhythm, density modes, container queries, and responsive layout primitives.
- [Status legend](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/status-legend): Stability tiers and readiness criteria for components in @innostes/ui.
- [Typography](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/typography): Typography scale, fluid type tokens, font stacks, and tabular numeric rules for enterprise ERP interfaces.
- [Next.js App Router](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/frameworks/nextjs): Complete integration guide for Next.js App Router, Server Components, dark mode with next-themes, and styling.
- [Vite React](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/frameworks/vite): Complete integration guide for Vite React projects with Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and dark mode.
- [Introduction](https://innostes.com/ui/docs): Enterprise UI component library for ERP and operations systems, built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS.
- [Installation](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/installation): Install @innostes/ui, configure stylesheets, set up providers, and verify your build.
- [Application shell](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/app-shell): Composable layout scaffolding for multi-tenant enterprise dashboards.
- [Complex forms](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/complex-forms): Architecture for multi-section data entry, validation, and unsaved changes.
- [Data management](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/data-management): Patterns for enterprise data tables, batch actions, and filtering.
- [Patterns](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/index): Reusable composition recipes for enterprise application architectures.
- [Theming & Design Tokens](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/theming): Semantic design token architecture, OKLCH colour system, theme overrides, multi-tenant scoping, and generated token reference.

## Components
- [Button Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/button-group) [Stable]: Segmented container joining adjacent buttons horizontally or vertically for pagers and split actions.
- [Button](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/button) [Stable]: Foundation action trigger supporting multiple semantic variants, sizes, loading spinners, and render polymorphism.
- [Actions](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/index) [Stable]: Core interactive controls for submitting forms, triggering commands, and toggling states.
- [Toggle Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/toggle-group) [Stable]: Segmented control managing single or multiple active states with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation.
- [Toggle](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/toggle) [Stable]: Accessible two-state pressed button primitive for formatting toolbars, favorites, and view modes.
- [Avatar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/avatar) [Stable]: Image avatar with graceful fallback initials, circular and square geometries, and overlapping avatar groups built on Base UI.
- [Badge](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/badge) [Stable]: Semantic status indicators with soft tinted backgrounds, contrast-hardened ring tokens, and optional pulse dots.
- [Card](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/card) [Stable]: Structured card container composed of header, title, description, actions, content, and footer primitives.
- [Data Table](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/data-table) [Stable]: Rich data grid supporting typed columns, multi-row selection, server-side data fetching, skeleton loading, and container-query mobile card transformations.
- [Empty State](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/empty-state) [Stable]: Clean empty state representation with icon container, title, explanatory description, and primary/secondary action triggers.
- [Icon Tile](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/icon-tile) [Stable]: Visual icon container offering semantic and categorical chart tones, soft/solid treatments, and four standard sizes.
- [Data display](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/index) [Stable]: Components for structured record presentation, hierarchies, and metric highlights.
- [Kbd](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/kbd) [Stable]: Monospace key badge styled with borders and subtle elevation for communicating shortcuts in tooltips, menus, and help docs.
- [Stat](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/stat) [Stable]: Compact KPI summary tile with automatic trend direction inference, customizable sentiment polarities, and icon slots.
- [Table](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/table) [Stable]: Accessible HTML table building blocks for displaying custom tabular breakdowns, invoice summaries, and financial ledger items.
- [Tree View](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/tree-view) [Stable]: Nested tree structure featuring roving focus keyboard navigation, type-ahead search, expandable child levels, and loading spinners.
- [Alert](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/alert) [Stable]: In-flow status callout with semantic variants, automatic ARIA role management (alert vs status), and integrated iconography.
- [Gauge](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/gauge) [Stable]: Accessible SVG radial meter with dynamic threshold coloring, customizable radius dimensions, and normalized range calculations.
- [Feedback](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/index) [Stable]: Decision guides, severity wording principles, and UI components for communicating system status, background tasks, and operation outcomes.
- [Meter](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/meter) [Stable]: Scalar measurement indicator with semantic tones, normalized percent calculations, and full WAI-ARIA meter semantics.
- [Progress](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/progress) [Stable]: Accessible progress indicator supporting determinate progress, indeterminate pulse animations, and normalized percent formatting.
- [Skeleton](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/skeleton) [Stable]: Accessible content loading placeholder that prevents Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and respects reduced motion preferences.
- [Spinner](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/spinner) [Stable]: Circular loading glyph with automatic aria-status management, size utilities, and decorative hiding toggles.
- [Toast](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/toast) [Stable]: Framework-agnostic imperative toast manager with success/error shortcuts, promise resolution tracking, and accessible politeness priority queues.
- [Calendar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/calendar) [Stable]: Single and range modes, min/max bounds, disabled dates, one or two month views, and Intl-based locale formatting.
- [Checkbox](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/checkbox) [Stable]: Accessible checkbox primitive supporting single agreement boxes, multi-select tables, and indeterminate "select all" parent groups.
- [Combobox](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) [Beta]: Accessible combobox input for filtering and selecting values from extensive or remote dataset collections.
- [Date Picker](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/date-picker) [Stable]: DatePicker and DateRangePicker with built-in presets, min/max bounds, clearing triggers, and standard YYYY-MM-DD form submissions.
- [Field and Form](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/field) [Stable]: Accessible form container linking labels, descriptions, and errors with native constraint validation and server error mapping.
- [File Dropzone](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/file-dropzone) [Beta]: MIME type and extension checking, file size and count constraints, image thumbnails, and native form integration.
- [Forms](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/index) [Stable]: Input fields, pickers, validation containers, and specialised editors for complex data entry.
- [Input Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/input-group) [Stable]: Unified input container merging leading and trailing addons, copy triggers, and currency labels.
- [Input](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/input) [Stable]: Accessible single-line input field supporting multiple types, clear buttons, password visibility toggles, and automatic Field wiring.
- [Locale Selects](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/locale-select) [Stable]: Pre-configured searchable select components returning standard ISO and IANA codes with zero third-party dataset bundle overhead.
- [Number Field](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/number-field) [Stable]: Accessible numeric input field supporting min/max bounds, wheel stepping, and en-IN currency and percent formats.
- [Radio Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group) [Stable]: Accessible radio group primitive for selecting exactly one option from a visible set of choices.
- [Rich Text Editor](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/rich-text-editor) [Beta]: Bold, headings, lists, quotes, links, and history shortcuts packaged in a modular entry point with form validation support.
- [Searchable Select](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) [Stable]: Filterable single-select dropdown matching labels and keywords with accent-insensitive search.
- [Select](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/select) [Stable]: Accessible dropdown selection menu with groups, separators, multiple selection, type-ahead, and automatic Field wiring.
- [Slider](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/slider) [Stable]: Accessible slider component supporting single values, dual-thumb price ranges, keyboard stepping, and form submission.
- [Switch](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/switch) [Stable]: Accessible binary switch primitive with animated thumb sliding, sizes, and instant state synchronization.
- [Tag Input](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/tag-input) [Beta]: Removable chip tag entry control supporting autocomplete suggestions, delimiter pasting, maximum bounds, and validation.
- [Textarea](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/textarea) [Stable]: Accessible multiline text input supporting field-sizing auto-resize, rows configuration, and automatic Field wiring.
- [App Rail](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/app-rail) [Stable]: Compact module navigation rail with active states, accessible tooltips, and badges for enterprise multi-app suites.
- [Form Layout](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/form-layout) [Stable]: Container-query powered grids (FormGrid), titled sections (FormSection), and persistent action bars (FormActions).
- [Layout](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/index) [Stable]: Scaffolding primitives for responsive ERP application shells, navigation bars, and data panes.
- [Page Header](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/page-header) [Stable]: Standardized page header bringing together breadcrumb, h1 title, status badges, and primary actions.
- [Scroll Area](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/scroll-area) [Stable]: Native momentum scrolling, keyboard accessibility, and styled auto-hiding scrollbars across all operating systems.
- [Separator](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/separator) [Stable]: Horizontal or vertical divider with semantic separator semantics and RTL logical layout support.
- [Sidebar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/sidebar) [Stable]: Collapses to icons on desktop, slides in on mobile, with groups, badges, tooltips, nested submenus, and keyboard shortcut (⌘B).
- [Split Pane](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/split-pane) [Beta]: Draggable, keyboard-accessible split canvas with percentage-based bounds, collapse thresholds, and double-click reset.
- [Top Bar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/top-bar) [Stable]: Responsive application header with semantic slots (TopBarStart, TopBarCenter, TopBarEnd) and translucent blur support.
- [Accordion](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/accordion) [Stable]: Single or multi-expanded collapsible sections with animated height transitions and keyboard support.
- [Breadcrumb](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/breadcrumb) [Stable]: Linear ancestral navigation with router integration, current-page indication, and ellipsis support for deep paths.
- [Collapsible](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/collapsible) [Stable]: A flexible disclosure primitive for secondary form options, filter expansions, and collapsible detail cards.
- [Navigation](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/index) [Stable]: Structures and controls that guide operators through multi-step journeys and hierarchical data.
- [Pagination](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/pagination) [Stable]: Controlled page navigation with stable button widths, boundary offsets, and server-side range calculation.
- [Stepper](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/stepper) [Stable]: Horizontal or vertical multi-step indicator with validation status, step descriptions, and clickable navigation.
- [Tabs](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/tabs) [Stable]: Underline and pill variants with animated active indicator, keyboard navigation, and vertical orientation support.
- [Alert Dialog](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/alert-dialog) [Stable]: Strict modal confirmation dialog that disables backdrop light-dismiss, focuses the safe cancel action by default, and communicates consequences clearly.
- [Command Palette](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/command-palette) [Stable]: A global command overlay triggered by keyboard shortcut (⌘K) to quickly search records, navigate pages, and execute administrative actions.
- [Context Menu](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/context-menu) [Stable]: Pointer-anchored action menus supporting submenus, keyboard shortcuts, and toggle items.
- [Dialog](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/dialog) [Stable]: Modal dialog with automatic focus trapping, backdrop blur, Escape and outside-click dismissal, and five content size tiers.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/dropdown-menu) [Stable]: Groups, keyboard shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, submenus, and destructive row actions.
- [Overlays](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/index) [Stable]: Layered interface elements with detailed decision matrix, focus management guarantees, and mobile responsiveness.
- [Popover](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/popover) [Stable]: Small forms, share panels, and pickers that float next to their trigger without blocking background content.
- [Sheet](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/sheet) [Stable]: Drawer overlay supporting four directional edges, RTL-aware logical sides, scrollable body containers, and master-detail responsiveness.
- [Tooltip](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/tooltip) [Stable]: Names icon buttons and shows shortcut hints with shared warm-up delay across toolbars.

## Widgets
- [Action List](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/action-list) [Stable]: Actionable task queues pairing descriptions, status icons, and dedicated resolution buttons.
- [Activity Feed](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/activity-feed) [Stable]: Compact list and connected timeline views with relative timestamps, day groupings, and status tones.
- [App Switcher](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/app-switcher) [Stable]: Popover launcher with grouped application sections, descriptions, status icons, and built-in search.
- [Change Log](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/change-log) [Beta]: Audit trail with field-level before and after values, notes, actor identities, and day grouping.
- [Entity List](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/entity-list) [Stable]: High-density business entity rows with avatars, status metadata, and row actions.
- [Widgets](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/index) [Stable]: High-level business blocks combining primitives with built-in loading, empty, and error contracts.
- [Kanban Board](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/kanban-board) [Beta]: Interactive multi-column board with optimistic drag-and-drop moves, WIP limits, touch support, and full keyboard navigation.
- [Metric Card](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/metric-card) [Stable]: High-density business metric cards with delta indicators, comparison baselines, sparklines, and progress bars.
- [Notifications](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/notifications) [Stable]: Popover notification trigger with unread badge counter, relative timestamps, and standalone list component.
- [Permission Matrix](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/permission-matrix) [Beta]: Interactive permission grid with module grouping, row and column bulk toggles, read-only roles, and sticky headers.
- [Quick Actions](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/quick-actions) [Stable]: Shortcut launcher cards for high-frequency tasks such as creating orders, invoices, or dispatch notes.
- [Sparkline](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/sparkline) [Stable]: Zero-dependency SVG trendline rendering clean fills and strokes without external chart libraries.
- [User Menu](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/user-menu) [Stable]: User profile button that opens a dropdown menu with avatar fallbacks, status subtitles, and account actions.
- [Welcome Banner](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/welcome-banner) [Stable]: Top-of-dashboard greeting card with container-query responsiveness, background variants, and quick action buttons.
- [Widget Card](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/widget-card) [Stable]: Standardized dashboard card frame with headers, count badges, actions, view-all links, and built-in loading, empty, and error states.

## Charts
- [Cartesian Charts](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/charts/cartesian) [Stable]: Bar, Line, and Area charts for categorical business analytics with accessible hidden tables, en-IN formatting, and Recharts integration.
- [Donut Chart](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/charts/donut) [Stable]: Donut chart for visualizing proportions and percentage shares with prominent center metrics, en-IN formatting, and accessible hidden tables.
- [Charts](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/charts/index) [Stable]: Accessible, theme-aware charting primitives for financial summaries and inventory analytics.

## Patterns and Examples
- [Dashboard](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/examples/dashboard): An HRMS dashboard bringing together the Sidebar, AppRail, TopBar, MetricCards, charts, and dashboard widgets.
- [Setup Wizard](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/examples/setup-wizard): Brand panel, stepper, responsive form grid, locale selects, validation and a wizard footer.

- [FAQ](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/faq): Frequently asked questions regarding @innostes/ui installation, theming, and usage.

- [Migration guides](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/migration): Upgrade instructions and breaking change migrations between major versions.
- [Security](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/security): Security practices, vulnerability reporting, and dependency auditing.
- [Versioning and support](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/versioning): Semantic versioning policy, release lifecycle, and browser compatibility targets.
